signals.signal: BoA primary terminal series (F6_TERMINALS_T2): ATM estate jumped to 1,414 at end-Q2-2026 from 1,147 at Q1-2026 and 1,091 at end-2025 (+29.6% in six months, +39.9% y/y vs 1,011 end-2024). Confirms the disputed ~1,011 2024 figure as BoA's own. Provisional (quarterly, unaudited).
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Numri i terminaleve (ATM dhe POS), F6_TERMINALS_T2_Shqip
signals.implies: Albania is one of very few CEE markets ADDING ATMs fast - direct NCR Atleos dispense/deposit hardware + x-core multivendor software and managed-services opportunity.
signals.followup: Identify which banks added ~320 ATMs in H1-2026 (check BKT/Credins/OTP/Raiffeisen Albania releases).

signals.signal: Cash-deposit-capable ATMs reached 458 of 1,414 (32.4%) at end-Q2-2026, from 430 end-2025 and 396 end-2024; ATM credit-transfer-capable 363. H1-2026 ATM deposits 1,378,900 txns worth 68,594.6m lek vs ATM withdrawals 11,006,228 txns / 192,364.0m lek - deposits are now 35.7% of withdrawal VALUE. Provisional.
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - F6 terminals + Transaksione sipas terminaleve Qershor 2026
signals.implies: Deposit/withdrawal value ratio above ~1:3 is the classic threshold where cash recyclers (an ATM that re-dispenses notes customers deposited) beat separate deposit+dispense machines - Glory/Sesami TCR and NCR recycling plus APTRA OptiCash cash optimisation.
signals.followup: Ask BoA/banks how many of the 458 deposit ATMs are true recyclers vs deposit-only.

signals.signal: POS estate 38,662 at end-Q2-2026 (EFTPOS 38,615) from 31,263 end-2025 and 24,481 end-2024; virtual POS 389; e-money-accepting terminals 9,452 (from 7,322 end-2025). H1-2026 POS card payments 16,006,404 txns (+~28% y/y) worth 58,263.4m lek. Provisional.
signals.implies: Fastest POS rollout in the Printec footprint - Verifone/Castles terminals, TMS and softPOS/tap-to-phone for the long tail of small merchants.
signals.followup: Reconcile with press figure of 27,969 POS at mid-2026 (Monitor 27/08/2026) - different measure.

signals.entity: Bank of Albania - AECH retail clearing
signals.signal: AECH (national retail payment clearing house, small-value interbank credit transfers) hit a record 237,974 transactions in July-2026 alone worth 62,714.6m lek; Jan-Jul-2026 cumulative 1,395,629 txns / 375,304.9m lek, of which 1,219,314 initiated by commercial banks. Monthly volume rose from 162,793 (Jan-2026) to 237,974 (Jul-2026), +46% in seven months, partly driven by BoA Decision no.45 of 03/09/2025 raising the AECH accepted-payment limit. Provisional (monthly, unaudited).
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Te dhena mujore mbi klerimin e pagesave ne sistemin AECH 2026
signals.implies: A retail clearing house growing 46% in seven months while a TIPS-clone instant rail is being built is exactly the ISO 20022 / instant-payments integration and transaction-monitoring (INETCO) workload Printec sells; also raises 24/7 liquidity and cash-forecasting pressure (APTRA OptiCash).
signals.followup: Get BoA Decision no.45/03.09.2025 text for the new AECH value ceiling, and confirm whether AECH is being retired or kept alongside the TIPS clone.

signals.signal: AIPS-EURO (the domestic euro settlement system through which Albania's SEPA credit transfers clear) processed 287,956 customer euro payments worth EUR 4,337.4m in Jan-Jul-2026 alone, versus BoA's own count of ~363,000 SEPA transfers worth EUR 4.3bn in the FIRST SIX MONTHS after Nov-2025 accession - i.e. euro-payment value in seven months of 2026 already matches the entire first SEPA half-year. Monthly count rose 31,545 (Jan) to 49,005 (Jul), +55%. BoA still labels the flow 'MT103', a legacy SWIFT message type, not ISO 20022. Provisional (monthly, unaudited).
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Te dhena mujore per sistemin AIPS-EURO 2026
signals.implies: An MT103-labelled euro rail inside a SEPA member is a migration gap: ISO 20022 / SEPA message transformation, sanctions and AML screening on the new cross-border volume (IMTF Siron, FICO) and transaction monitoring are directly sellable.
signals.followup: Confirm with BoA/Albanian Association of Banks whether AIPS-EURO messaging is pacs.008 or still MT103 in production, and the current count of SEPA-reachable Albanian banks (11 at accession).

signals.signal: H1-2026 BoA instrument statistics (F1) show PAPER-BASED credit transfers are still 3,250,200 transactions worth 2,477,883m lek - 33% of all customer credit transfers by count and 62% by VALUE - against 6,568,781 non-paper (internet 3,260,880 / mobile 3,247,108, telephone and computer banking both zero). Home-banking transactions reached 6,568,781 in H1-2026 worth 1,512,017.5m lek, versus 11,529,651 for the whole of 2025 (+14% run-rate) and 9,357,535 in 2024. Provisional (quarterly, unaudited).
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Pagesat sipas instrumenteve 2026 (F1_T2) + Transaksione home banking ne vite
signals.implies: Two-thirds of transfer VALUE still crossing a paper counter is the clearest branch-transformation case in the footprint: self-service kiosks, assisted-service teller automation and cash recyclers to move high-value business transfers off the counter, plus digital onboarding/e-signature (Namirial) to dematerialise the paper mandate itself.
signals.followup: Split the paper transfers by bank; ask which banks still require wet-ink mandates (Namirial e-signature entry point).

signals.entity: Bank of Albania (Valentina Semi, Deputy Director, Payment Systems Dept)
signals.signal: BoA officially confirms Albania's domestic INSTANT payment system on the Banca d'Italia 'TIPS Clone' goes live in NOVEMBER 2026 - settlement within 30 seconds, 24/7, embedded inside banks' existing mobile apps, with in-store mobile payment and bill-splitting as launch use cases. BoA states fees will be 'much cheaper than cards' with real-time liquidity to merchants (vs T+1 to T+4 on cards), and a World Bank-BoA cost study puts first-year savings at ~1.5bn lek if half of current payments migrate (wider economy-level estimate 35-40bn lek). Domestic first, then regional/EU extension.
signals.source_name: Gijotina (BoA official interview) - 'BSH: Nga nentori, pagesat elektronike brenda 30 sekondave me sistemin TIPS Clone'
signals.implies: A hard ~Nov-2026 instant-payments go-live inside every Albanian bank's mobile app is the single biggest integration deadline in the market: ISO 20022 gateway work, 24/7 real-time fraud and transaction monitoring (INETCO), AML screening (IMTF Siron / FICO), HSM key management for the new rail (Thales) and softPOS/QR merchant acceptance all land in the same 12 weeks.
signals.likelihood: High - officially stated by BoA, 3 months out
signals.followup: Get the BoA primary (Supervisory Council decision / press release) naming the exact go-live date and the participating banks; confirm whether the national QR scheme launches with it.

signals.entity: Printec Albania Ltd / Bank of Albania banknote-machine certification
signals.signal: BoA's official list of CUSTOMER-OPERATED banknote-handling machines tested for the lek contains only TWO entries, and Printec Albania Ltd is the named distributor for BOTH: NCR SelfServ 6682/6684/6632/6634 (category CCM = combined cash-deposit machine, hardware/software v.1.46.01, tested 20/02/2026) and LIVIX 7 (Vivex Group, Belgrade; category CIM = cash-deposit machine, tested 30/01/2026). Critically, BOTH are marked 'Jo' (No) in the column 'machine capable of processing by FITNESS' - under BoA Regulation 15/2013 fitness checking is the condition for re-circulating lek banknotes, so as of mid-2026 NO customer-operated machine in Albania is certified to RECYCLE notes; deposits must go back through a staff-operated sorter (the tested staff list is all Giesecke+Devrient BPS / Cima, distributors Mellon Albania and Pelikani Security, latest test 24/06/2026).
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Lista e makinerive te perdorura nga klientë (Tabela 2) and Lista e makinerive te testuara nga BSH
signals.implies: Printec already owns the certified customer-facing cash-automation channel in Albania, and the missing FITNESS certification is the gate that currently blocks true cash recyclers (an ATM that re-dispenses notes customers deposited) in a market where deposits are already 35.7% of ATM withdrawal value. Getting an NCR/Glory recycler through BoA fitness testing converts an incumbency into a recycling upgrade cycle across ~458 deposit-capable ATMs.
signals.likelihood: High - Printec is the incumbent distributor of record
signals.followup: Submit an NCR/Glory fitness-capable recycler for BoA testing under Regulation 15/2013; check the Rregullore page for any 2026 amendment to 15/2013.

signals.signal: [STANDING - dated end-2025] Bank branches rose to 408 at end-2025 from 405 at end-2024 and 385 at end-2023, and grew again in Q1-2026 - Albania's branch network is EXPANDING, against the regional trend, from a 2012 peak of 556 branches/agencies; one physical banking unit per ~5,792 residents. This is press reporting of BoA supervisory data; the ~390 branch figure previously carried from thecptgroup.com is not BoA-sourced and should be dropped.
signals.source_name: Revista Monitor / Ora News, reporting Bank of Albania supervisory data
signals.implies: A growing branch estate plus 62% of transfer value still on paper means new-branch fit-out demand: teller cash recyclers (TCR), self-service kiosks and assisted-service devices per branch, plus managed field services across a widening footprint.
signals.followup: Extract the exact quarterly branch series from the BoA Annual Supervision Report 2025 (Raporti Vjetor i Mbikeqyrjes 2025) - the only primary source that publishes it.

signals.signal: Cash in circulation reached ~546bn lek at end-July 2026, up from ~501bn lek in January 2026 - +45bn lek (~9%) in seven months, with July alone adding ~18bn lek. Cash is therefore growing FASTER than the ~28% POS-terminal expansion is displacing it; a separate report put money outside banks at ~481bn lek in Jan-2026 vs ~422bn a year earlier, so the exact level is disputed between press readings and needs the BoA primary. Provisional / press-derived.
signals.source_name: JavaNews.al reporting Bank of Albania data (cross-checked against scantv.al / reporter.al)
signals.implies: Cash volume rising in absolute terms alongside record POS/ATM growth is the classic 'cash is not dying, it is being automated' case: cash recyclers, APTRA OptiCash cash-cycle optimisation, CIT route reduction and IBNS/anti-skimming physical ATM security all scale with note volume, not with card share.
signals.followup: Pull 'Paraja jashte korporatave depozituese' from the BoA Agregatet Monetare database (Dec-2023 to Jul-2026) for the clean primary series - the web form did not yield data to curl this run.

signals.entity: Albanian banking sector - branch teller cash
signals.signal: BoA Form 3 (teller cash transactions) shows H1-2026 OVER-THE-COUNTER cash volumes of 3,357,815 transactions worth 1,170,783.6m lek - businesses 1,659,610 txns / 798,312.6m lek and individuals 1,698,205 txns / 372,471.0m lek. Cash DEPOSITS at the teller alone were 2,279,914 txns worth 783,700.3m lek, against ATM deposits of 1,378,900 txns worth 68,594.6m lek over the same half-year: the branch counter still absorbs ~11x the cash-deposit VALUE that the whole ATM estate does. Provisional (quarterly, unaudited).
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Formulari 3: Transaksione cash ne arke, Viti 2026 (F3_dhe_F4_T2)
signals.implies: The clearest teller-cash-recycler (TCR) case in the footprint: 783.7bn lek of business and retail cash deposited manually across a GROWING 408-branch network is exactly the Glory/Sesami TCR + NCR cash-automation and APTRA OptiCash workload, and the business-deposit concentration (575.2bn lek) points at bulk-note deposit devices in commercial branches.
signals.followup: Identify the 3-4 banks with the largest business cash-deposit share (BKT, Credins, OTP, Raiffeisen Albania) and pitch TCR branch pilots ahead of the Nov-2026 instant-payments launch.

signals.entity: Albania - Parliament / AKSK (National Cyber Security Authority)
signals.signal: The Albanian Parliament adopted on 07/05/2026 the law 'On electronic identification, trusted services and the digital identity wallet', fully aligned with the EU eIDAS1 and eIDAS2 regulations. It creates a free-to-citizens Digital Identity Wallet able to store and share identity attributes, sign and seal documents electronically through secure devices embedded in the wallet, log every digital interaction, and work offline and cross-border; it also widens the range of qualified and non-qualified trust services and hardens security requirements on eID schemes and trust-service providers, with supervision powers assigned over wallets, schemes and providers.
signals.source_name: AKSK (Autoriteti Kombetar per Sigurine Kibernetike) - 'Miratohet ligji Per identifikimin elektronik, sherbimet e besuara dhe portofolin e identitetit digjital'
signals.implies: An eIDAS2-aligned wallet law starts an 18-month bank integration cycle: qualified e-signature and remote onboarding/eKYC (Namirial), wallet-based customer authentication for the Nov-2026 instant-payments rail, and the qualified-trust-service plumbing behind it - the direct route to killing the 3.25m paper credit transfers still crossing branch counters.
signals.likelihood: High - law adopted, implementing acts pending
signals.followup: Track AKSK secondary legislation and the accreditation route for qualified trust service providers in Albania; check whether Namirial can passport an existing EU QTSP status.

signals.signal: E-money CARDS in issue went 235 (2023) -> 1,021 (2024) -> 2,503 (Q1-25) -> 12,433 (Q4-2025) -> 17,059 at Q1-2026, a ~17x rise in two years off a tiny base, while e-money ACCOUNTS reached 326,376 at end-2025 (269,765 in 2024; 152,862 in 2023). Terminal transactions with e-money ran 3,626,015 in Q1-2026 alone (of which 83,074 card-based, the rest software/wallet), against 14,369,604 for the whole of 2025. Provisional (quarterly, unaudited).
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Paraja Elektronike (Mars 2026): Kartat e parases elektronike + nr. llogarive nder vite
signals.implies: EMIs are moving from pure wallet/software to plastic and tokenised cards - a card issuing & management, personalisation and HSM/PCI-PIN key-management opportunity (Thales, remote key injection) at exactly the point these non-bank issuers must also connect to the Nov-2026 instant rail.
signals.followup: List Albania's licensed EMIs (BoA register) and check which already issue physical cards vs which would need an issuing/personalisation partner; Easypay is the first open-banking licensee.

signals.signal: [LEADING INDICATOR] Home-banking transactions hit 6,568,781 in H1-2026 worth 1,512,017.5m lek, versus 11,529,651 for FULL-YEAR 2025 and 9,357,535 in 2024 - a run-rate ~14% above 2025 and a 4.7x rise since 2019. Within that, MOBILE banking overtook internet banking by count in Q1-2026 (1,532,789 vs 1,498,485) and stayed close in Q2 (1,714,319 vs 1,762,395), while telephone and computer banking are both flat ZERO. Individuals dominate mobile (2,291,956 of 3,247,108 H1 txns) but businesses dominate value. Momentum proxy, not a structural count; provisional.
signals.source_name: Bank of Albania - Transaksione home banking ne vite + F1_T2 Pagesat sipas instrumenteve 2026
signals.implies: Mobile-first crossover 3-6 months BEFORE the Nov-2026 instant-payments launch means the instant rail lands in an app estate that is already the primary channel - accelerating demand for real-time fraud/transaction monitoring (INETCO), strong customer authentication and digital-channel platform work, and for kiosks to serve the shrinking non-digital minority.
signals.followup: Track Q3-2026 home-banking file for the confirmed mobile>internet crossover, and Albanian bank app store rating-count growth as a second momentum proxy.
